name.value: Go/No-Go task with visual negative feedback

description.value: Two separate 10-minute trials of a Go/No-Go task. Participants responded to Go (x) stimuli with a single button press and withheld responses to No-Go (k) stimuli. Correct but late Go responses elicited visual negative feedback reading “Too Slow”.

instructions.value: Respond as quickly as possible to x stimuli by a single button press and withhold response to k stimuli.

stimuli.value: White x and k letters on a black screen; the visual negative feedback stimulus was the text “Too Slow”.

value: button_press
